name: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd
title: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd - 524715 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Sun Pharma Q1 FY27 sales up 10.1% with India formulations +16%, but US generics fell 9.7% on Lenalidomide erosion; no capacity or capex signals, so supply-side read is neutral.

summary.headline: Sun Pharma Q1 FY27 sales rose 10.1% to INR151,836 million; EBITDA up 2.7% to INR44,177 million with 28.9% margin.
summary.overview: Consolidated sales grew 10.1% YoY to INR151,836 million, with gross margin at 80.5% on product mix. EBITDA rose 2.7% to INR44,177 million, and margin fell YoY because Q1 FY26 included Lenalidomide benefit. Reported PAT was INR28,948 million and adjusted PAT INR30,894 million, after a INR1,617 million Organon acquisition-related exceptional charge. India formulations grew 16% to INR54,749 million, while US sales fell 9.7% to USD427 million on Lenalidomide erosion and generic competition. Management held high single-digit full-year sales growth guidance and said the Organon deal is expected to close in Q4 FY27.

segments.name: Global Innovative Medicines
segments.commentary: Sales USD351 million, up 12.8% YoY, 21.9% of consolidated sales; growth led by ILUMYA, ODOMZO and CEQUA across US and ex-US.

segments.name: India formulations
segments.commentary: Sales INR54,749 million, up 16%; market share 8.5% per Pharmarack MAT June 2026 (8.2% prior), ranked number 1; volume growth 5.4% vs IPM 2%. Five new products launched in Q1.

segments.name: US
segments.commentary: Sales USD427 million, down 9.7% YoY, driven by Lenalidomide erosion and added competition in generics; QoQ decline partly seasonal for Levulan. Five generic launches in the quarter.

segments.name: Emerging markets
segments.commentary: Formulation revenues USD311 million, up 4.2% YoY, 19.4% of consolidated revenue; management cited geopolitics and macro conditions.

segments.name: Rest of World
segments.commentary: Formulation revenues USD218 million, marginally lower YoY and flat QoQ, about 13.6% of consolidated revenue.

guidance_outlook: Full-year FY27 sales growth guidance of high single digit retained, with management flagging FX translation as a factor.
Effective tax rate expected in a similar range to Q1 (around 27.8%) until Organon closing.
Organon acquisition expected to close in Q4 FY27 (early 2027); further acquisition-related exceptional charges expected in later quarters, mostly accrued at closing, with no full estimate given.
R&D spend guided to annual number; management expects to meet it despite lower Q1 spend.
Other expenses expected to stay elevated from continued launch investment (Leqselvi, Unloxcyt), FX translation and normalising R&D; no specific number given.
capex_capacity: Semaglutide: API made in-house, formulation in-house, device components sourced from partners; company says it is prepared to meet demand in India, South Africa and Brazil.

Semaglutide generic launched in India from March 2026 (number 2 generic player; only company offering an auto-injector in India), launched in South Africa after approval last week, Brazil launch via partner expected shortly.
Organon integration management office working on day-one preparedness; regulatory filings complete and some approvals received.
demand_pricing: India: management attributed 50% of growth to volume and new products (later said 60% of growth from volume and new products, 40% volume and 20% new products); field force expansion aiding tier 2 and tier 3 growth. Management declined to explain industry growth step-up beyond June being strong.
US Leqselvi: over 1,000 prescribers in June, strongest month since launch, majority of covered lives now available after a new plan added in the quarter.

US Unloxcyt: launched earlier in 2026, formulary additions at cancer centers and integrated delivery networks; Medicare Part B product; updated ASCO 2026 data showed more than one in four patients achieving complete tumor response.
Levulan seasonality hit the QoQ US comparison; management expects similar seasonality next quarter.
Emerging markets growth slowed to 4% USD; management cited geopolitics and macro conditions and said pricing pressure was not the main driver. ROW flat at USD218 million for a second quarter.
Semaglutide slowdown reports in India were disputed by management, which said Sun grew in prescriptions, value and units.

qa_highlights.question: Why did specialty growth decelerate in Q1?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined product-level detail; Levulan seasonality was the only specific cited factor, with similar seasonality expected next quarter.

qa_highlights.question: How much semaglutide supply is secured for FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said API and formulation are made in-house, device components are contracted, and it is well prepared for India, South Africa and Brazil.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the sharp step-down in US generic revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Largest part is Lenalidomide on a YoY basis; QoQ decline is a slight base business drop from competition on a few products.

qa_highlights.question: Gross margin trend and sustainability?
qa_highlights.answer: Driven by product mix, with higher shares from branded generics and innovative medicines; CFO did not give a forward margin level.

qa_highlights.question: Is top-line guidance conservative after 10.1% Q1 growth?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said to stick to high single-digit full-year growth, citing FX translation that is positive so far but uncertain for the rest of the year.

qa_highlights.question: Why did employee cost rise faster than revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Annual increments, additional field force for the two US launches and other innovative markets, and forex translation.

risks_watch: US generic erosion from Lenalidomide and added competition, with no clear turnaround timeline.
Emerging markets growth slowed to 4% USD; watch whether geopolitical and macro pressure persists.
Organon closing (Q4 FY27) and rising acquisition-related exceptional charges with no full estimate.
Launch costs for Leqselvi and Unloxcyt are sustained, not one-time, which keeps other expenses elevated.
Effective tax rate rising to about 28% as India tax benefits are used up.
Management withheld product-level revenue, Unloxcyt share and Leqselvi revenue timelines, so the launch ramp is not yet measurable.
summary.management_tone: Confident on India, semaglutide and launch-prescriber metrics, but evasive on product-level revenue, US generic outlook, and emerging market slowdown. Management repeatedly declined to give product or timing detail and fell back on guidance already given.
key_quotes: We're seeing good momentum in Leqselvi with prescriptions and the number of prescribers expanding each month.
Think we should stick on to the high single-digit growth for the full year.
The largest part of the decline is Lenalidomide.
I don't know what you are referring to slowdown.

growth.why: Management held high single-digit FY27 sales growth (midpoint ~8%) with India formulations up 16% on volume and new launches, offset by US sales down 9.7%; no specific new capacity was quantified, and the Semaglutide capacity is described only qualitatively.
